item.title: Saints rookie Brock Rechsteiner, Scott Steiner's son, suplexes teammate
item.summary: Brock Rechsteiner, the Saints rookie and son of WWE Hall of Famer Scott Steiner, became part of a heated Saints-Cowboys practice fight after giving Jalen Thompson a German suplex. Rechsteiner is trying to earn an NFL roster spot after joining New Orleans as an undrafted receiver, while his six-game suspension will keep him out of the start of the regular season.
